summary: ③ Measure node built. New lib/measure.js: parseNumber(stdout,parse) [last_number sentinel + regex-1-capture, throws if none], runMeasure(worktree,spec)->{value,guardrails} (bounded execSync timeout, non-zero exit throws), evalGuardrails(spec,baseGR,measGR)->regressed list, regressed(dir,base,meas). overlay.js: measurements{} map in EMPTY()+setMeasurement(merges, so baseline+attempt coexist)+load back-fill+export. daemon.js: POST /task/measure {key,baseline?,repo_path?} resolves repo via resolveRepo (no workspace hardcode), runs in attempt worktree (createWorktree) or repo root if baseline:true, stores overlay.measurements[key]; surfaces `measurement` on node + /task/detail. MCP tool measure_task. README + test/measure.test.js (29 pass) + smoke.sh measure section (5 checks). Tests: 29/29 unit, 68/68 smoke, sibling tests green. Daemon NOT restarted — dormant until user restarts :8787.
